name: Moped
description: A pedal-equipped vehicle on no more than three wheels, weighing 55 kg or less, whose motor of 1.5 kW or less, or 50 cc or less, can't push it past 50 km/h without pedalling and needs no clutching or shifting. The province names a power-assisted bicycle but never defines one, so an e-bike within these limits, the federal 500 W and 32 km/h e-bike included, is a moped.

restrictions.rule: Steering handlebars, pedals that can propel it, and no more than three wheels
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(mm)

restrictions.rule: A motor of 1.5 kW or less, or 50 cc or less, that can't reach more than 50 km/h on level ground without pedalling, with no clutching or shifting once engaged
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(mm)

restrictions.rule: Weighs 55 kg or less, not counting fuel or a starting battery
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 2(mm)

restrictions.rule: A motor vehicle but not a motorcycle: registered, licensed, plated and insured to be driven on a highway
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, ss. 2(nn), 2(oo), 10 and 75

restrictions.rule: Riders need a driver's licence; Class 5 covers motor vehicles with no more than two axles, while Class 6 covers motorcycles only
restrictions.citation: Highway Traffic Act, R.S.N.L. 1990, c. H-3, s. 43; Highway Traffic Driver Regulations, 1999, N.L.R. 110/98, s. 3

restrictions.rule: The rider and any passenger must wear a fastened motorcycle helmet meeting CSA D230, FMVSS 218, ECE 22.05, Snell or British Standards Institution standards
restrictions.citation: Licensing and Equipment Regulations, C.N.L.R. 1007/96, s. 44

restrictions.rule: Needs a service brake on each wheel and a red tail lamp visible from 150 m
restrictions.citation: Licensing and Equipment Regulations, C.N.L.R. 1007/96, ss. 10 and 25

restrictions.rule: One heavier, faster or more powerful is a motorcycle
